description: Validates file and function quality checks through tidiness-manager.

capabilities.label: Scan Contract
capabilities.description: Target resolution and normalized maintainability scan output.

levels.name: No tidiness target
levels.description: Tidiness Manager cannot resolve a scenario or readable source tree for maintainability scanning.
levels.capability_summary: Tidiness scanning has no readable target.
levels.next_unlock: A scenario or path that resolves to readable source files.

levels.name: Scan available
levels.description: The provider can run the maintainability scan and return normalized findings.
levels.capability_summary: Tidiness Manager can return normalized scan output.

levels.name: Scan contract clean
levels.description: The scan completes with structured findings, summary counts, and shared maturity metadata.
levels.capability_summary: The maintainability scan contract is clean.

capabilities.label: Local Debt Control
capabilities.description: File-size boundaries and explicit technical-debt marker density.

levels.name: Local debt unknown
levels.description: Tidiness Manager cannot evaluate file size or local debt markers.
levels.next_unlock: Readable source files and maintainability metrics.

levels.name: Debt visible
levels.description: Long files and technical-debt markers are visible as normalized findings.
levels.next_unlock: Files stay within reviewable size and marker thresholds.

levels.name: Debt controlled
levels.description: Files stay within reviewable size boundaries and debt markers remain below maintainable thresholds.
levels.capability_summary: File-size and local debt-marker posture is controlled.

levels.name: Local debt clean
levels.description: No long-file or dense technical-debt findings remain.

capabilities.label: Complexity And Coupling
capabilities.description: Branching complexity and broad import-surface maintainability risk.

levels.name: Complexity unknown
levels.description: Tidiness Manager cannot evaluate complexity or coupling.
levels.capability_summary: Complexity and coupling cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: Function and import-surface metrics are collected.

levels.name: Complexity visible
levels.description: Highly branched functions and broad import surfaces are visible as normalized findings.
levels.capability_summary: Complexity and coupling risks are visible.
levels.next_unlock: High-complexity and high-coupling findings are below blocking thresholds.

levels.name: Complexity controlled
levels.description: Highly branched functions and broad import surfaces are kept below local maintainability thresholds.

levels.name: Complexity clean
levels.description: No high-complexity or high-coupling findings remain.

capabilities.label: Duplication Control
capabilities.description: Duplicated implementation blocks and copy-drift risk.

levels.name: Duplication unknown
levels.description: Tidiness Manager cannot evaluate duplicated implementation blocks.

levels.name: Duplication visible
levels.description: Duplicated implementation blocks are visible as normalized findings.
levels.next_unlock: Duplicated-code findings are below blocking thresholds.

levels.name: Duplication controlled
levels.description: Duplicated implementation blocks are low enough that fixes and behavior changes do not drift across copies.
